description: Hand-authored unanswerable queries for LegalBench-RAG-mini (CUAD, 29 indexed contracts). FROZEN: do not edit after the improvement loop starts. Split is computed at load time with assign_split(query).
method: Authored by category (absent topic, nonexistent contract/party, information not specified in a real contract, off-domain). Each query lists absence_check_terms; validate-data verifies none occurs (case-insensitive) in any indexed contract. Absence was checked lexically against the indexed corpus only; this is not a legal determination.

queries.query: What cryptocurrency or blockchain token is used to settle payments under this contract?
queries.rationale: No indexed contract mentions cryptocurrency, blockchain or bitcoin.

queries.rationale: No indexed contract concerns aircraft; neither term occurs.
